title: 第十一章 二叔找茬第十二章 顾文来村
content_zh:
“滚！”
王海娇舍不得揍小宝，一脚踢在亲弟弟小腿上可半点不留情，痛得王海生惨叫一声，落荒而逃。
殷东笑着，先把蒸锅上水，那条石斑鱼清蒸了，把先前没吃完的蒸腊肉也放进蒸锅里，然后把海鲈鱼做了个火锅，又用黑鲷做了个红烧全鱼，鱼在锅里烧的时候，他去菜园里摘了五条黄瓜，还是做的刀拍黄瓜，就这么端上桌。
王海生还说：“东子，以前也没见你烧菜啊，你这速度都可以开餐馆了。
我们这牌都没打几盘呢，你这菜都上桌了。”
“赶紧吃吧你，过不了几个小时，你就得出海了。”
殷东说着，把小宝接了过来，又道：“娇姐，你也吃点吧。”
“行，我来尝尝东子的手艺。”
王海娇也不客套，拿了筷子开吃，这一吃就停不下来了，还说：“东子，姐以后天天来你家蹭饭了，太好吃了！”
王海生也说：“尽管我姐有拍马屁的嫌疑，不过，我还是要说个公道话，东子的手艺还真不错。
所以，我决定以后跟我姐一起来蹭饭。”
其他人也都夸殷东做的菜好吃，表示要来蹭饭。
殷东笑而不语，重生以前，他在酒店当过学徒，尽管没出师，在这种偏远的小渔村，更是凸显他烧菜的水平。
王海生他们离开的时候，都不肯带走今晚钓的鱼，殷东只得把鱼都剖了，把冰箱塞满后，余下还腌了一大盆。
然后，殷东倒头就睡，直到小宝饿得抱着他的脸啃，才醒了过来，发现己经差不多快中午了，赶紧爬起来给小宝冲牛奶，自己把剩菜热了一下，胡乱吃了点。
下午，殷东抱着小宝，把菜园收拾了一番，回屋来正准备烧水给小宝洗个澡，就听到外面有车开到了大门口，大金隔着大门汪汪的叫起来。
“大金，不要叫。”
殷东喊了一声。
狗叫声停止，他二叔又喊了起来：“东子，开门！
你个狼心狗肺的狼崽子，竟然污赖你二婶卖你儿子，没人性的东西，你那个灾星儿子克死了你爸妈，还要来祸害我们一家子吗？”

殷东的眼睛顿时红了，发狂的豹子似的冲了出去，拉开大门，一拳头砸出去。
他二叔殷海文猝不及防，被一拳砸在脸上，鼻血狂飙，整个倒跌出去。
殷东跟上去，又是一阵拳打脚踢，打得他二叔鬼哭狼嚎。
左邻右舍看热闹的人这才过来拉架，看他二叔被打得鼻青脸肿，口鼻出血，都纷纷指责殷东下手太狠。
殷东也懒得答理，只盯着他二叔问：“你脑子装的都是狗屎？派出所是我开的，我让警察抓人，人家就抓？你给吴金莲保释的时候，警察不让保释，你怎么不给她喊冤？吴金莲犯的案子，可不止一件，你不想办法跟吴金莲划清界线，就不怕被怀疑是她同谋？”
这话虽然是骂殷海文的，可是拉架的村民们都闭嘴了，而殷海文也怂了，色厉内茬的说：“要不是你告你婶子，王海娇能带人去抓她吗？”
“你在污蔑警察。”
殷东嘲讽道，眼睛却看着人群外的王海生父子几个，相信他们应该忍不住了吧。
content_en:
"Get out!"
Wang Haijiao couldn't bear to beat Xiaobao, so she kicked her younger brother in the calf without mercy. The pain made Wang Haisheng scream and run away.
Yin Dong smiled, first filled the steamer with water, steamed the grouper, put the uneaten steamed bacon into the steamer, then made a hot pot of sea bass, and made a braised whole fish with black sea bream. While the fish was cooking in the pot, he went to the vegetable garden to pick five cucumbers, and made a knife to beat the cucumbers, and served it to the table.
Wang Haisheng also said: "Dongzi, I've never seen you cooking before. You can open a restaurant at this speed.
We haven't even played a few games of this card yet, and your dish is already on the table. "
"Eat quickly, you'll be out to sea in a few hours."
Yin Dong said, took Xiaobao over, and said: "Sister Jiao, you should eat some too."
"Okay, let me try Dongzi's craftsmanship."
Wang Haijiao didn't show any politeness. She took her chopsticks and started eating. She couldn't stop eating and said, "Dongzi, I will come to your house every day to eat. It's so delicious!"
Wang Haisheng also said: "Although my sister is suspected of flattering her, I still want to be fair, Dongzi's craftsmanship is really good.
So, I decided to have dinner with my sister in the future. "
Others also praised Yin Dong's cooking for being delicious and expressed their intention to come and share the meal.
Yin Dong smiled and said nothing. Before his rebirth, he worked as an apprentice in a hotel. Although he never graduated, his cooking skills in such a remote fishing village were even more outstanding.
When Wang Haisheng and the others left, they refused to take away the fish they caught tonight. Yin Dong had to cut open all the fish, fill up the refrigerator, and marinate the rest in a large basin.
Then, Yin Dong fell asleep and waited until Xiaobao was so hungry that he hugged his face and gnawed on his face. Then he woke up and found that it was almost noon. He quickly got up and made milk for Xiaobao. He heated up the leftovers and ate some randomly.
In the afternoon, Yin Dong held Xiaobao in his arms and tidied up the vegetable garden. When he returned to the house and was about to boil water for Xiaobao to take a bath, he heard a car outside driving to the gate, and Daijin barked through the gate.
"Dajin, don't scream."
Yin Dong shouted.
The dog barking stopped, and his second uncle shouted again: "Dongzi, open the door!"
You are such a wolf-hearted bastard, you actually accused your second aunt to sell your son, you are inhumane. Your scourge son killed your parents, are you going to harm our family? "
Yin Dong's eyes suddenly turned red, and he rushed out like a frantic leopard, opened the door, and punched out with his fist.
His second uncle Yin Haiwen was caught off guard and was punched in the face. His nosebleed violently and he fell down.
Yin Dong followed him and kicked and punched him again, making his second uncle cry like a ghost.
People watching from the neighbors came over to start a fight. Seeing that his second uncle's nose was bruised and swollen, and his mouth and nose were bleeding, they all accused Yin Dong of being too harsh.
Yin Dong didn't bother to answer, just stared at his second uncle and asked: "What are you pretending to be? I opened the police station, and I asked the police to arrest people, and they arrested them? When you gave Wu Jinlian bail, the police refused to let her bail, why didn't you cry out for her injustice? Wu Jinlian has committed more than one case. If you don't find a way to draw a line with Wu Jinlian, are you not afraid of being suspected of being her accomplice?"
Although these words were meant to scold Yin Haiwen, the villagers who started the fight all shut up, and Yin Haiwen also got cold feet and said sternly: "If you hadn't sued your aunt, could Wang Haijiao have led someone to arrest her?"
"You're slandering the police."
Yin Dong mocked, but looked at Wang Haisheng and his son outside the crowd. I believe they couldn't help it anymore.
